LESSON: THE CELL

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 2.1: The Cell
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Cell, part of Living Things and their Environment in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 INTEGRATED SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How do plant and animal cells differ?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collaboratively prepare, mount, observe and draw plant cells as seen under a light microscope, (include a reminder on

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Cell together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: The learner learns how to prepare, mount, observe and draws plant cells as seen under a light

microscope.

● Self-efficacy: The learner successfully prepares and observes specimens under the light microscope.

Values:
● Unity: The learner displays team spirit as they prepare, mount, observe and draw plant cells as seen under a light

microscope.

● Responsibility: The learner performs assigned roles as they observe, draw and label animal cells on permanent slides as

seen under the light microscope.

Link to other learning areas:

As the learner carries out multiplication of objective lens and eye piece lens to get the magnification, concept of multiplication

is learnt in Mathematics.
